topicsPlaceholder.message:
software engineering, programming
machine learning research
video games, game design
topicsPlaceholder.description: Three example topics, one per line.

topicsHint.message: One topic per line, a few words each. Posts about anything else get blurred out. You can always click a blurred post to read it.

blacklistPlaceholder.description: Three example keywords to block, comma-separated.

blacklistHint.message: Separate keywords with commas or new lines. Any post that contains one is blurred, even when it is on topic. Case and accents don't matter, and a singular also blocks its plural.

tipsSummary.message: How to write a good topic

tipWordsBody.message: One word is too vague. More than five and each one counts for less.

tipKeywordsBody.message: Every word counts, so small words like “and” or “posts about” only blur what you're asking for.

tipCommasBody.message: “software, programming” and “software programming” work the same. Use whichever you prefer.

tipLinesBody.message: Put a separate subject on its own line. A post that matches any line stays visible.

tipVocabBody.message: “software” works better than “tech”, because people write about the thing, not the category.

tipQualityBody.message: A great post and a poor one about the same thing both stay. uFeed can't tell them apart.

saveLists.description: Saves both the whitelist topics and the blacklist keywords.

strictnessOff.message: Blurs nothing — every post stays visible.

strictnessTradeoff.message: Stricter hides more, including some posts you'd want. Blurred posts stay one click away.

modelOptionEnglish.description: Dropdown option. The download size is part of the choice.

modelOptionMultilingual.description: Dropdown option. The download size is part of the choice.

modelHintEnglish.message: Reads English only. Small, and quick on every post.

modelHintMultilingual.message: Reads every language and sorts more accurately, even in English. Slower on every post; downloads once.

details.description: Label of every collapsible help section in the popup.

modelDetailsEnglishBody.message: Small and quick on every post, and it only reads English. It is also more particular about how a topic is worded, so keep topics to a few keywords.

modelDetailsMultilingualBody.message: Reads every language and sorts your feed more accurately, even in English. It is more forgiving of how a topic is worded. The cost is a 197 MB one-time download and more work on every post.

modelDetailsKept.message: Your topics, strictness and thumb ratings are all kept when you switch. Ratings are stored per model, so each model keeps its own and switching back restores them.

blurMediaLabel.message: Blur images and videos with no text

blurMediaDetails.message: uFeed reads words, not pictures. When a photo or video has only a word or two with it, there is nothing to compare against your topics. Turn this on to blur those posts instead of letting them through.

blurLanguageLabel.message: Blur posts that aren't in English
blurLanguageLabel.description: Names the language the default model reads. Only shown with that model.

blurLanguageDetails.message: uFeed only understands English. It can't tell whether a post in another language is about your topics or not, so it lets some through and blurs others at random. Turn this on to blur them all — including ones that are on topic.

blurLanguageRefresh.message: Posts already on screen stay as they are. Scroll on, or reload the page, to see the change.

blurLanguageOff.message: Switched off because the multilingual model reads every language — there is nothing left for it to blur. Your setting is kept for when you switch back.

collapseLabel.message: Collapse blurred posts into a thin row

collapseDetails.message: Instead of leaving a blurred post at full height, shrink it down to a thin row so it takes up almost no space while you scroll past. The label still shows, and a click reveals it like any other blurred post.

scoresDetails.message: Adds a small label to every post showing the score it got, the score it needed to stay visible, and how long it is. Useful for working out why something was blurred.
scoresDetails.description: The label itself is a diagnostic and stays in English in every locale.

thumbsIntro.message: Hover over a post to give it a thumb up or down.

thumbsUpMeans.message: 👍 means this content belongs in the topic.

thumbsDownMeans.message: 👎 means this content does not belong in the topic.

thumbsCorrect.message: A correct call — blurred or shown — needs no correction.

thumbsScope.message: A thumb only changes posts that are almost the same as the one you rated, such as a repost or a quote. Everything else is judged by your topics as usual, so a thumb never hides a good post by accident.

thumbsPrivacy.message: Your ratings stay on this device. One catch: it only compares the words in a post. If the real content is in the image or video and the words are forgettable, skip it. Leave this off and the buttons stay hidden.

tuningNone.message: You have not rated any posts yet.

backupHint.message: Saves your settings and thumb ratings to a file. Importing replaces what is here now.

importPrompt.description: Followed on the same line by importPromptTail.

importDone.description: Follows the name of the imported file.

resetHint.message: Restores the defaults and deletes your thumb ratings. Your topics and language are kept.
